name: starting architecture
last_analysis: No scores are visible, so I have to choose using priors and the structure of the design space. Every trial trained without errors. Two ideas look like the most promising directions. First, the FootHead, which pairs landing information with each cell, targets the main skill the task needs: judging whether a placement is correct and sealing nothing it shouldn't. Second, recipes with fewer epochs give more fresh designs, and the budget favours that because training designs never repeat. These two ideas have only been combined at 2 epochs (r3c1). The deep dilated trunk with a global summary (r2c2) is the only test of wider context without attention, and it was never paired with the FootHead or the 2-epoch recipe. Because this is the final round and selection uses real 2-seed scores, I propose three strong combinations that differ from each other. Each one adds a single change on top of the FootHead with fewer epochs, which raises the chance that at least one beats the start.
